Trump Campaign Ads Funded by Homeland Security Funds

Television advertisements supporting Donald Trump's presidential campaign were financed with at least $2.5 million from Homeland Security funds, according to reports. The ads were purchased on networks including CNN and MS NOW. The White House has defended the use of taxpayer money for this ad campaign, while Trump has also reportedly sought to prevent these networks from covering the White House.
